scripts.build:all: pnpm build:website && pnpm build:launcher && pnpm build:mods
scripts.clean: rm -rf launcher/dist launcher/src-tauri/target website/.next website/out mods/*/build
scripts.release:tag: git tag -a v$(node -p "require('./package.json').version") -m "Release v$(node -p "require('./package.json').version")" && git push origin v$(node -p "require('./package.json').version")
